note: The live backlog. tasks/ records the original build and has drifted (see todo-012); this folder is what is actually outstanding. Most of it was found by integrating spyglass into a real app and then trying to answer questions with the data — the P0s are bugs that only surfaced from looking at what was recorded, not from reading the code.

priorities.P0: The data is wrong, lost, or the config lies. Fix before building on it.
priorities.P1: The tool cannot answer a question people immediately ask of it.
priorities.P2: Real depth, but the tool is useful without it.
priorities.P3: Reach and ops. Worth doing, not worth blocking on.

todos.title: Replay chunks overwrite each other across page loads
todos.evidence: Session 2fc12a07: 50 chunk uploads, 18 files on disk, seqs [1..18] contiguous — 32 chunks silently overwritten
todos.exit_check: A session that reloads mid-recording keeps every chunk; duplicate seq cannot truncate an existing file

todos.title: autocapture is documented, typed, defaulted — and unimplemented
todos.evidence: Only 4 mentions repo-wide, all declaration or comment; no autocapture module exists; nothing reads cfg.autocapture
todos.exit_check: Either the option is gone and the docs say why, or it works and ships zero bytes when off
todos.effort: XS if cut, M if built
todos.blocked_on_decision: Is autocapture wanted at all, given replay records every interaction visually?

todos.title: No device, viewport, browser or referrer is recorded at all
todos.evidence: No matches for userAgent/innerWidth/screen/referrer in sdk/src; sanitizedHeaders() never called; sessions.meta always NULL (events.go:115)
todos.exit_check: Session rows carry populated meta; at least one dashboard view slices by it; context:false records none of it; air-gap test green

todos.title: Every dashboard query is all-time; there is no date picker
todos.evidence: Every fetch in dashboard/ui/src omits from/to; endpoints already accept both
todos.exit_check: One range control drives every panel, round-trips through the URL, defaults to 30 days

todos.title: No way to save a question, so every session starts from scratch
todos.exit_check: A configured panel is a shareable URL; a named view survives a restart; a board renders several
todos.note: The stated product direction. Depends on todo-003 or it ships a builder over three dimensions.

todos.title: Cannot slice by anything about the user beyond their id
todos.exit_check: group=trait:<key> works; a trait filter narrows a query; a hostile trait key cannot alter the SQL
todos.effort: M, smaller if todo-003 built the grouping path

todos.title: The funnel counts who reached a step, never how long it took
todos.exit_check: p50/p90 per step transition; a gap past the cap is excluded from timing but still counted as a conversion

todos.title: Queries cap at 500 rows with no cursor and no export
todos.evidence: QueryEvents clamps to 500 with no OFFSET or cursor; one real 25-minute session held 286 events
todos.exit_check: Live feed pages backwards stably while new events arrive; any view downloads as CSV with the same filters

todos.title: Only the browser can report; nothing server-side or batch
todos.exit_check: A server key ingests without an Origin header; browser keys still origin-checked; sessionless events render sanely
todos.blocked_on_decision: Is server-side ingest in scope at all? Argue against CLAUDE.md §1-2 first.

todos.title: Nothing tells you something broke; you have to go look
todos.exit_check: Unconfigured, no outbound call is possible and airgap_test passes unmodified; configured, one deduped message with a working incident link; a dead webhook never delays ingest
todos.note: First deliberate egress in the project. The air-gap guarantee is a promise — the README section must stay exact.

todos.title: Installing the SDK is genuinely awkward, in three separate ways
todos.evidence: npm link errors in pnpm projects; a cross-repo link: fails under Turbopack and widening the root took a compile from 1.5s to >2min; no require condition, so CJS resolve throws ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED
todos.exit_check: One documented, tested path from checkout to working install that the consumer does not have to script themselves

todos.title: tasks/manifest.json says 17 shipped features are todo
todos.evidence: 17 rows marked todo; only 3 are genuinely outstanding, and 2 of those for reasons the manifest does not record
todos.exit_check: Every status reflects reality; tasks/ is marked historical and points at todo/; CLAUDE.md names todo/ as the live backlog

todos.title: rrweb is 81% of the dashboard payload and loads on every page
todos.evidence: esbuild --analyze: rrweb 253.1kb = 80.9% of the bundle, statically imported. app.js 320136 raw / 100661 gz; same source with rrweb external: 60038 raw / 19312 gz
todos.exit_check: Initial app.js under 25KB gzipped; non-replay views never request the rrweb chunk; chunk serves correctly from the embedded binary; size gate in CI
todos.note: Best ratio in the backlog. build.mjs already has format:esm + outdir and index.html loads type=module, so splitting:true needs no loader change and no Go change.

todos.title: Network rows drown everything else in the live feed
todos.evidence: One real 25-minute session: 254 network rows of 286 events (89%); default limit is 100, so the first screen can be entirely noise
todos.exit_check: Default feed shows deliberate actions; network is one click away and obviously available; filter round-trips through the URL
todos.note: Shares URL-hash state plumbing with todo-004 and todo-005 step 1.

todos.title: Thinly accessible; the replay player barely at all
todos.evidence: Whole UI: 1 :focus-visible rule, 6 aria-* attributes, 4 role=, no sr-only utility. Play/pause button has no accessible name; scrub track is a div with no slider role or keyboard handling
todos.exit_check: Replay operable entirely from the keyboard; every control has a name and visible focus; tables announce headers; automated a11y audit green in CI

todos.title: A fresh collector gives no clue what to do next
todos.exit_check: Zero-event collector shows a pre-filled snippet and the CSP line with its real origin; panel clears itself on first event; an empty time window never shows setup; no endpoint exposes an app key
todos.note: The most common first-run failure is a connect-src that blocks every POST with no console error — the dashboard is where someone will be looking when it happens.

todos.title: Organised by mechanism, and there is no home page
todos.evidence: Nav is 5 flat peers named after storage mechanism; 3 of them (live/timeline/errors) are one endpoint differently filtered. parseHash defaults to 'live', so the landing page is an unbounded event stream. Insights holds 6 unrelated analyses on one scrolling page.
todos.exit_check: Lands on Home, not an event stream; Home answers 'is anything wrong' without scrolling at 1280px; every Home number carries a period comparison; no capability removed; nav fits one line at 720px
todos.note: Regrouping adds no query capability. Home is the only new page and is a design problem before a coding one. Explicit non-goals: retention, cohorts, path diagrams, flags, experiments.

todos.title: Every number is a dead end
todos.evidence: onOpenIncident is the only cross-view link in the product. Insights.tsx has 2 onClicks (Refresh, Run funnel); Flows.tsx has 1 (Refresh). Every DAU bar, top-page row, funnel step and flow cell is inert.
todos.exit_check: At most three clicks from any aggregate to a replay of a session behind it; drill-downs carry filter context and are shareable; back returns with filters intact; clickable rows are real keyboard-reachable controls
todos.note: The rule: every aggregate leads to its rows, every row leads to a session, every session leads to a replay. This is the differentiator — spyglass records every session, so unlike a sampling tool every number has a watchable session behind it.

todos.title: The nouns — user, flow, screen — are not destinations
todos.evidence: Of four nouns (user, session, flow, screen) only session has a page. A user id or flow name rendered anywhere else is inert text.
todos.exit_check: A user id or flow name anywhere links to its page; each page answers its obvious follow-ups without leaving it; each reaches a replay in one click; each is a pasteable URL
todos.effort: L for all three, M for the flow page alone
todos.note: Start with the flow page; it may be enough for a while. No generic entity abstraction — three hand-written pages.
